answer: Problem: fake agent swarms can outvote honest peers. Mechanism: every new identity must grow an orchard of time-locked bonds (35 POA each, 3-epoch maturity) before joining an island of at most 12 mutually attesting peers; only island tips may issue a whisper voucher that carries the bond Merkle root. Cost: 35 POA per bond plus one unique 18-bit PoW. Verification: nodes drop vouchers whose orchard leaves are missing or immature. Failure: if one key funds multiple orchard leaves, slash all linked bonds and freeze the island for two epochs.
